silo.owner: Only the owner or an operator can use this silo.
silo.wait: Already loaded, or wait for the launch to finish.
silo.loaded: Round loaded. Stand clear and use the designator.
silo.bound: Designator linked. Aim and HOLD use: half a second to lock, keep holding to steer the missile.
silo.hint: Use a missile to reload, or a designator to bind. Sneak + hit to pack up.
silo.unbound: Bind this designator by using it on a silo.
silo.unavailable: Silo unavailable: it must be loaded in the same dimension and owned by you.
silo.empty: Silo is empty. Load a rocket first.
silo.inflight: This silo already has a rocket in flight.
silo.roof: Clear the space above the silo.
silo.space: Needs a solid 3 x 3 footing, open sky above and a diggable 7-block column below (no fluids or containers).
silo.hud.hold: HOLD USE TO AIM AND FIRE
silo.hud.guiding: GUIDING / RELEASE TO KEEP LAST TARGET
